Psoas abscess: MRI of the lumbar spine: mild foraminal narrowing at L5–S1 but no central canal stenosis or abscess
Normal tumour markers, MRI of the hip, and an isotope bone scan argued against malignancy
Attempts at hip aspiration were unsuccessful
Colchicine was started for presumed crystal arthropathy and atorvastatin was discontinued for possible myopathy
Chief complaint: one week of increasing left leg pain and weakness, impaired mobility, and a single episode of urinary incontinence
Laboratory results: elevated inflammatory markers (CRP 76 mg/L, WCC 11.9 × 10^9/L, neutrophils 8.5 × 10^9/L) and pre-renal acute-on-chronic kidney injury
Left hip pain worsened despite analgesia, strength declined to 2/5 at the hip and 3/5 at the knee
MRI of the hips and pelvis: bilateral iliacus and iliopsoas muscle oedema with enhancement
